name: UF Mahjong!
source:
Visual Novel + Strip Mahjong Game.
This is a side story about the main character of "Ultimate Factory" in his third year of employment. Play strip mahjong with 11 various characters from the original game, and get their H scenes! Depending on your choices, you may unlock different endings.
